residual_risks: This record identifies the integrated source snapshot and proves only the bounded checks listed above. It is not a deployable or approved release and has no immutable frontend or backend deployment bindings.
The staging pooler role posture, route-complete two-tenant matrix, multi-replica revocation and outage behavior, passwordless timing, and controlled CSRF and SSRF canaries have not run.

Graph is release-disabled. Before graph promotion, FSMA audit append must move into one server-side transaction that serializes the global head and checksum, enforces the tenant contract, and removes direct runtime insert authority.
The shared TaskWorker has no lock heartbeat. A handler that outlives its visibility timeout may execute twice, although stale owners cannot overwrite terminal state.

The complete repository backend test suite and the seeded Playwright cross-service suite were not run. Focused backend gates and the full frontend unit, type, lint, build, dependency, and static-analysis gates passed.

The frontend was verified on its explicit Node 20 baseline, not on Vercel's current default Node 24 runtime. Any runtime change remains separate compatibility work; 35 non-blocking ESLint warnings and framework build warnings remain.
The disposable migration rehearsal used PostgreSQL 16. PostgreSQL 17 and the dedicated multi-role runtime suite were not run in this integration pass.
No candidate Vercel or Railway deployment, staging database mutation, production mutation, or credential rotation was performed.
